title: html-explain
summary: Draws a system as levels of boxes and arrows that you open one at a time, compare with a proposal, mark reviewed and comment on.
desc: The agent reads the code and writes one JSON spec. `build.mjs` checks it and makes one self-contained HTML page. In live mode, `serve.mjs` serves the page, passes each note to the agent, and pushes each new save of the spec back to the page.

findings.t: `applyOps` runs in Node for the check and in the browser for the page: `page()` inlines its source, so there is one copy.

nodes.label: Coding agent
nodes.desc: Reads the code, writes the spec, answers notes and puts agreed changes in the Proposed view.

nodes.label: SKILL.md
nodes.desc: Round 0 draws the system; live mode passes notes; each review round answers notes and updates `proposed`.

nodes.label: <name>.json
nodes.desc: The one source of the page: the tree of levels, the ops that make the proposed tree, the design log and the threads.

nodes.label: <name>.inbox.jsonl
nodes.desc: `serve.mjs` appends each note here. `--watch` prints each new line once; `<name>.inbox.cursor` keeps its place.

nodes.label: serve.mjs
nodes.sub: live mode: page, notes, spec pushes
nodes.desc: Serves the page on 127.0.0.1 with a random token, takes notes, and long-polls the page with each valid save of the spec.

nodes.label: HTTP server
nodes.desc: Answers only its own page: the token, the Host and the Origin must match.

nodes.label: Spec watcher
nodes.sub: a valid save is a new version
nodes.desc: A save that fails the check is reported and skipped; the page keeps the last good version.

nodes.label: --watch
nodes.desc: The agent's Monitor runs this. Each new note in the inbox prints one line, never twice.

nodes.label: check()
nodes.sub: ids, kinds, x/y, arrows, overlaps, thread keys
nodes.desc: Checks the current tree, then the proposed tree, and names each problem by its path.

nodes.label: applyOps()
nodes.sub: add · remove · change · edge · unedge · reedge
nodes.desc: Copies the tree and applies each op at its path. The page runs the same function.

nodes.label: page()
nodes.sub: inlines the spec, CSS and JS
nodes.desc: One HTML file that works offline. In live mode it also carries the server's token.

nodes.label: The page
nodes.desc: Outline on the left, one level in the middle, Details and Design log on the right.

nodes.label: Outline
nodes.sub: the open path, with status dots

nodes.label: Diagram
nodes.desc: A click selects a box. A click on its ▸ number, or a double-click, opens it.

nodes.label: Box summary
nodes.sub: kind · files · what it does · proposed change

nodes.label: Findings
nodes.sub: bug · simplify · dup, checked or not

nodes.label: Mark reviewed
nodes.sub: hides the box until Show reviewed

nodes.label: Notes thread
nodes.sub: answers · your notes · a draft that survives redraws

nodes.label: Hover preview
nodes.sub: shows a box in Details while nothing is selected

proposed.summary: A demo round: one box added, one changed, one removed.

node.label: Search
node.sub: find a box by name at any level
node.change: New: type a name, jump to its level and select it. See log 1.

set.sub: prints the box label after its key
set.change: The line names the box: note n1 on node:page/details (Details panel). See log 3.

log.title: 1 · Search across levels
log.text: Deep trees hide boxes. A search box finds one by name and opens its level.

log.title: 2 · No hover preview
log.text: Hover replaces the panel while you read it. With it gone, Details change only on a click.

log.title: 3 · Labels in --watch lines
log.text: A path alone is hard to read in a monitor. The line adds the box label.

page.text: Where do my notes go when the page is a plain file?
They stay in this browser. **Notes for the agent** copies them as one block to paste into the chat.

node:page/hover.text: Hover keeps replacing the panel while I read. Drop it.
Agreed: it is removed in Proposed (log 2). A click still shows any box.
